text: Functionalism is standardly classified as a form of non-reductive physicalism, combining token physicalism with the denial that mental types are identical to physical types.
explanation: True: functionalism combines token physicalism (each state-token is physical) with type non-identity (the mental type is not identical to any single physical type), which is exactly the non-reductive physicalist position. This is precisely why functionalism is compatible with multiple realizability.
